description: Company Incorporation Local page sections: hero, pricing packages, the free-tools tabs, the what’s-included cards, the two routes to getting started, the “Why founders choose us” bento, the shared Google Reviews slider, the shared FAQ and the final CTA. The testimonials_*, faq_* and cta_* field names repeat the Home and ROA groups’ names under different keys, which is what lets template-parts/testimonials.php, faq.php and cta.php stay page-agnostic. Everything is flat fields because ACF free has no Repeater — quantities are fixed by the layout, and empty entries are skipped rather than rendered blank.
